changelog: Release notes are available in-client and in official announcements.
latest_features: AutoBasehunt now uses a stronger square-spiral corner pass check so route turns keep advancing instead of stalling into straight-line flight
Added an AutoBasehunt route HUD panel with next 5 checkpoints, leg direction, and live distance readout
AutoBasehunt route HUD panel is now draggable and position-scalable with saved settings for consistent layout across sessions
AutoMapart placement now uses Nukkit-aware pacing and optimistic placement recheck for smoother ghost-to-place sync
AutoMapart target lock smoothing reduces jitter when transitioning between nearby map cells while keeping render and tick cost low
